A '''proximity fuse''' was a type of fuse that could be used in a [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]] to detonate the [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] if someone came in close proximity to it.

In about [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dal Konur]] installed a number of defences in a [[Hangar Bay 631-D|hangar bay]] in the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] and he placed some stun grenades equipped with proximity fuses inside two [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] located near to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].

[[Jedi shadow bomb]]s were also armed with proximity fuses, and the [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]-packed weapons were guided through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] by [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] before exploding against their targets.
